document: Bring back capital punishment for the rape of a child , Change the law to allow for the death penalty to be imposed to anyone convicted for raping a child., We believe there surely is no more heinous crime than this kind of physical and psychological damage imposed on our precious children. We believe that there are no success stories where full rehabilitation and ‘cure’ has taken place with regard to sexual attraction towards minors. These people are in our view the biggest blight on society.

Refuse ability to claim asylum for convicted criminals, We think people convicted of crimes are claiming asylum, but we think once they are found to have a criminal background they should be immediately deported. We think this could free up the time for what we consider to be genuine cases for asylum., We feel the system is currently overstretched by people who may not be genuine asylum seekers. We think people applying for asylum with a criminal conviction should be immediately removed due to their criminal convictions.

Stop "gender critical beliefs" being protected under the Equality Act, We think removing the protection of the Equality Act for "gender critical beliefs" could better protect trans, non-binary and gender diverse people. It could support organisations to properly protect this marginalised community, whose rights we believe are currently being attacked and politicised.
, We think protection of "gender critical beliefs" provides a way for people to discriminate against a minoritised group (trans/non-binary people). We think it makes it hard to address discrimination and can deter organisations from doing due diligence. Law tells them to both protect trans/non-binary people as well as people with "gender critical beliefs".

We believe "gender critical beliefs" being protected under the Act encourages inappropriate response to discrimination and hinders progress towards equality.

Levy vaccine manufacturers to fund Vaccine Damage Payments and remove indemnity, We think the manufacturers of the vaccines should pay for the damages, not the tax paying public. , We think the Government should remove their indemnity as we believe this could immediately increase the safety of their products as it puts back the "consequences" of any problem with their product into the equation.

Because we think it is dangerous to allow companies to make anything they wish to with no come back if it is lethal or damaging. Why should the people that did not profit from it at all pay for any damage it might cause? We think this could lead to malpractice. We think this is wrong in so many ways it defies belief that it exists now.

Introduce 20% maximum commission rate for private hire (ride hailing companies), To enable the drivers are paid reasonably, we think the commission kept by the ride hailing companies should be legally fixed to a maximum of 20%. We think this will mean that the competition between the companies can be maintained and the drivers will be paid fairly., We think that some ride hailing companies take too much profit and pay their drivers very little.

Create a public register of domestic abuse offenders, We think that domestic abusers should be put on a register like sex offenders are. We want there to be an easily accessible website where individuals can search by either name or location, to find those who has been convicted of domestic abuse against previous partners., The police receive a domestic abuse-related call every 30 seconds.
On average, one woman is killed by an abusive partner or ex every five days in England and Wales. It is estimated that around 3 women a week die by suicide as a result of domestic abuse.
 
By making the information public, we think it could prevent many women and children having to endure the pain of domestic abuse, as well as saving police time having to disclose under Clare's Law and reduce domestic abuse related incidents and call outs.

Allow British Citizens by Descent to upgrade their citizenship, Allow Citizens by Descent to upgrade their citizenship after a period of UK residency, so they can pass on citizenship to their children born abroad without further requirements., Remove the 3-year rolling residency requirement that limits them passing it on to ensure equality with all other British citizens.

Citizens by Descent can't pass British Citizenship to their children UNLESS their child is born in the UK, or they've lived in the UK for a continuous period of 3 years before the birth. Any prior residency outside this is disregarded and their children could be denied a British Passport.

The British Nationality (Irish Citizens) Act 2024, recent Canadian Court rulings and Naturalized British Citizens born overseas I see as highlighting this inequality.

Make Accents a Protected Characteristic under the Equality Act 2010, Currently, the UK constitution offers protection for minority groups under the Equality Act of 2010. Unfortunately, accent is not included as a characteristic within this despite the discrimination. 28% of Britons feel they have experienced prejudiced due to their accent., To alter the Equality Act would simply be a piece of secondary legislation which could be carried out be Bridget Phillipson MP (Minister for Women and Equalities, Secretary of State for Education). In a society which is becoming increasingly diverse and aims to break down barriers, accent is holding us back. Received Pronunciation or the Queen's English is most notably favoured by many, including employers, taking away opportunities from those with more defined accents.

Review the police response to assaults on mental health nurses, We want more protection for mental health nurses in cases of assault. Review the official action taken after an assault, to ensure that the assault and abuse of mental health nurses is taken seriously. Review how Operation Cavell has been applied to mental health nurses., We believe that assaults on mental health nurses are often not taken seriously by the police with some officers taking the attitude that 'it's part of your job'. Assault towards MH nurses should be treated the same as abuse in public or of nurses in acute services.

Ensure companies don't make excess profits to bring prices down to a fair amount, We think any profit margin above 30%is excessive. We want the government to negotiate with supermarkets and companies, who are making excessive profits, to use their profits to bring down prices. Alternatively, we'd like the Government to introduce a windfall tax on their profits., We feel this could help ease the cost of living crisis for millions of people. We believe this policy would show strong leadership and benefit the public.

Remove the need for people to have gender dysphoria to legally change gender, As of now, one of the requirements for someone to legally change their gender is to have been diagnosed with gender dysphoria. Parliament should remove this requirement and allow people to legally change their gender, even without the diagnosis of gender dysphoria., The NHS's inability to provide support at acceptable speeds can and will result in a diagnosis taking a long time to actually be processed. This is not only unacceptable, but could also create mental health problems for the person wanting to change their legal gender, which is completely unnecessary. Furthermore, the idea that this diagnosis is needed to change their gender reinforces the discriminatory ideology that transgender people are "mentally ill", which keeps prejudice alive.

Introduce mandatory life sentences for child sex offences, I would like harsher sentencing introduced for what are the worst of all crimes in my opinion. I feel that child sex offenders are treated with leniency and this feels to me to be a grave injustice., I personally feel that sexual crimes against children are the most serious of all. I believe that Britain has a rich tradition of justice and leading the world in ethical matters. I suggest that this would lead the world in showing there can be absolutely no tolerance for the abuse of children.

Revoke visas of parents whose children are convicted of serious violent crime, We think that parents whose children are convicted of serious crimes should have their visas revoked and should be deported. We think that the offenders should be deported too.,

Create a public register of domestic abuse offenders, Create a register like the sex offenders register to make it easier for people to know whether or not they are having a relationship with someone who has been convicted of domestic abuse and all charges relating., We currently have Claire’s law, however, a lot of people either think they don’t need to check or the thought doesn’t pop into their head and for some, that’s to late and can have disastrous consequences. A register like this will push offenders faces and names out their more and will * hopefully* prevent domestic violence from happening and deter people from committing these offences.

Require personal care in care homes to be done by carers of the same sex , Make it a requirement that residents in a care home only have same sex carers carrying out a residents' personal care. We think this would reduce the risk of sexual abuse of vulnerable people.,

We urge the UK Government to reform the family court system, CAFCASS, We want the government to reform the family court system to eliminate bias against men, ensure fair treatment in custody and visitation decisions, review the use of the balance of probabilities in domestic violence cases, provide better mental health support for men involved in family court, We urge the government to reform the family court system by addressing gender bias, ensuring fair treatment for men in custody and visitation cases, reviewing the use of the balance of probabilities standard, providing mental health support for men in family court proceedings, and making legal aid more accessible to fathers facing financial hardship. These reforms are essential to ensure fairness, protect men’s rights, improve the well-being of families, and create a more just system for all.

Replace RE with 'Equality and acceptance' in the national curriculum , I would like religious education within school settings to be changed to equality and acceptance and have the subject around not just religion but hidden disabilities. I want it to be a subject that informs kids about all kinds of equality and to accept children for who they are., I think hidden disabilities aren’t often spoken about like they should be, and I believe if “Religious education” was changed to “Equality and acceptance” children would be taught about hidden disabilities and how everyone is different but deserves to be accepted for who they are. I want religion and hidden disabilities to be one subject about how everyone is different but everyone matters just the same.

Give harsher sentences to child sex offenders, Give harsher sentences to child sex offenders and also  ones that get caught with images. Most don't even get a custodial sentence which is completely wrong.,

Student Nurses should get paid during placement, Student Nurses should be paid money during placement. They do 2300 hours of placement unpaid. As well as on top having to pay for travel, parking and other circumstances., As a student nurse myself we are not expecting alot! But something is better then nothing!

Provide funding for nit nurses to visit schools, Provide funding for nurses to visit schools and check children for head lice, I think this could help stop nits spreading in schools. Some parents do not treat their children and head lice can be passed on to other children as a result.

Reduce the state pension age for women due to menopause symptoms, I want the government to consider the physical effects of the menopause and reduce the age at which women can get their state pension., I have always wanted equality for all sexes/people whatever gender. However, the menopause can have dramatic effects upon a woman’s health which is well documented. I think it is too much to ask the menopausal woman to work until she is 67.

Require schools to notify parents with PR of welfare concerns about their child, I think the law needs changing so that all parents with Parental Responsibility get told if there is a problem with their child’s welfare, I want the government to change the law so that all parents with PR and no history of violence and abuse get notified through the school etc when a child is in danger i.e. Suicidal thoughts and self harm. I think it should be compulsory that parents are notified when there is a risk to the child's welfare. I think social Services should get involved if a parent withholds this information from the other parent. I think schools should automatically inform the other parent regardless of parental disputes.

Order the Prime Minister to break down the £22billion black hole, The Prime Minister and Chancellor should give a detailed breakdown of the £22billion black hole, they insist they inherited from the previous government, The electorate have a right to know how the details of the £22b black hole, as this has been constantly referred to by the PM and the rest of the cabinet, with no actual evidence to corroborate the claim

Stop the Nordic-Model in Scotland, We want government to stop the implementation of the Nordic Model.

Trafficking and consensual sex work is not the same. Trafficking should be tackled as a seperate problem., Workers all around Glasgow are crying out for parliament to listen to them. We are grown people and should be allowed to work the way we want, and not be penalised for it.

If the Nordic-Model is introduced, criminals will push trafficking further underground.

Please leave us to do what we want.

Student Nurses to be paid apprenticeships wage., As a student nurse we attend placement and complete 2300 hours of FREE work covering the gaps of short staffing. However students should be learning with the nurses to ensure the nurses of the future are equipped with the right skills to help prevent further health inequalities in the UK., Please sign our petition it takes 2 seconds to change the future of health care! Student nurses are used daily to cover HCA role due to short staffing and should be recognise for covering these shortages. It could improve training and improve health outcomes in the future. Student nurses don’t get long summers off to work additional jobs to provide for themselves or their families. Let improve the education system for nurse and build a stronger workforce for the future.

Repeal the Coronavirus Act 2020, We want the act fully repealed. Temporary provisions lapsed in 2022, but we feel its framework lingering risks future democratic overreach. We think repeal restores normal oversight, ends emergency-era controls, & reflects lessons learned. We believe temporary measures should not outlast their need., We feel the Act represented the largest implemented expansion of state power since the Second World War.
We think existing legislation such as the Public Health (Control of Disease) Act 1984 and/or Civil Contingencies Act 2004, exist to deal with future health emergencies, without sweeping powers that we feel received little scrutiny or democratic oversight prior to Royal Assent.
Repealing this Act emphasises democratic principles, civil liberties, and lessons learned from COVID-19.

Suspend parental rights when arrested on suspicion of murdering the child, We call on the government to suspend all parental rights when a parent is arrested upon suspicion of murdering their child.  We believe once they are arrested, they should not, for example, have the right to be involved in funeral arrangements., We believe the rest of the family should be able to say goodbye to the child that has been taken away from them.

Make the sex offender's registry publicly available to view for everyone., Make the sex offender's registry publicly available to view for everyone, I think everyone should be able to view if there is a high risk individual in their area.

Minimum 15 Years sentence for sexual offences against a minor., I would like the Government to increase the minimum custodial sentence for any offenders found guilty of Sexual offences including, grooming and also sending and recieving indecent images of children to a minimum of 15 Years., I'd like parliament to increase these sentences to deter these criminals from committing these crimes against children as I believe the law in place now it's too soft.

Lower the age of child criminal responsibility for attacks and murder, Lower the age that a child can face criminal prosecution for an act of physical violence, sexual violence, sexual abuse, sexual assault and or murder on other children. We think it should be lower than 10.,

Remove parental responsibility from parents with criminal records, We want the Government to change the law so parents who have committed criminal offences, have criminal records and are criminal offenders, such as those on the sexual offenders list, have their parental responsibility over their children automatically removed.,

Harsher punishments for sex offenders and bans near schools, We urge the government to enforce harsher penalties for sex offenders, including longer sentences, mandatory rehab, and a ban on living near schools or child-centric areas., We urge the government to enact stronger laws to protect children and communities. This includes harsher penalties for sex offenders, residence bans near schools and child areas, and swift prosecution. We think these actions will deter offenders, protect vulnerable individuals, and ensure justice is served quickly.  We think it's time to prioritize safety and take firm action against sex offenses to create safer environments for all.

Revoke Parental Responsibility & Rights from Sexually Abusive Parents, Revoke parental responsibility and rights from parents who sexually abuse their children. We need to be our children's voices and protect them at all costs., The National Police Chief's Council found that CSAE within the family environment remains a common form of reported abuse, accounting for an estimated 33% of reported contact CSAE crime. Parents and siblings were the two most common relationships featuring. Currently, parents who sexually abuse their own child get to the keep their parental responsibility to that child and any other child they have mothered/fathered.

Appeal to uk supreme courts ruling on gender identity, Appeal to supreme court to change the ruling of what they identify sex or gender, Millions of transgender people now feel unsafe and will have more discrimination brought towards them.

Amend Equality Act to define the terms woman and man not based on biological sex, We believe trans women are women and therefore deserve the same rights as cis-gendered women, and that trans men are men and therefore deserve the same rights as cis-gendered men. We think the rights of human beings are being stripped away by defining people based on biological sex., We believe that people are getting their human rights taken away, because the government won’t view them in any way other than science. They are human beings and we think the UK supreme court ruling that the legal definition of a woman is based on biological sex, is more harmful to these human beings than you realise. Many trans people and non-binary people have mental health problems such as anxiety, depression and eating disorders. We think this is only going to get worse.

Introduce a legal requirement for transgender and non-binary only spaces, Where trans and non-binary / gender non-conforming individuals are excluded from single sex spaces in line with their affirmed gender, we think organisations should be required to provide dedicated genderless or trans spaces in lieu., We think this is needed as a result of the recent Supreme Court ruling. We think the provision of safe spaces free from discrimination and harassment must be provided. We believe trans women in men's spaces are more at risk of actual, psychological and physical harm and that the government must provide for reasonable alternatives in light of the court ruling.

Revise Supreme Court's ruling on definition of 'woman' to include trans women, The Supreme Court's decision on the definition of 'woman' in the Equality Act 2010 and the Gender Recognition Act 2004 to not include trans women is discrimination. Trans women are women. This decision has very real consequences and will cost the lives of countless trans women., Whilst the Supreme Court re-affirmed the Equality Act protects all trans people against discrimination, based on Gender Reassignment, the implication that being protected as a 'women' means you must have been born as a biological 'women' undermines the existence of trans women completely, suggesting that because they were biologically born male that they don't count as women. This decision must be revised to ensure trans women are protected as 'women' as well as being protected as trans people.
Reverse Supreme Court ruling that Trans women are not women, give rights back!, Reverse the ruling completely, Give trans people in the UK their rights back

Overrule the supreme courts decision to define woman as biological sex, Overrule the supreme courts decision to define woman as biological sex and instead define it as the secondary sexual characteristics of a female.

Legally defining biological sex leaves transgender individuals, and those other hormonal disorders open to discrimination., We feel that transgender and intersex people should be able to adopt the appropriate roles in society that match their gender identity and not be segregated by their gender reassignment  - however with the new definition of biological sex there is no way to protect them without outing them as transgender which is a risk to personal security.

Reverse Supreme Court ruling excluding trans women under the Equality Act 2010, Amend the Equality Act 2010 so that the term ‘woman’ includes transgender women with Gender Recognition Certificates and self identified women and protect their rights to access women-only spaces and services., The recent Supreme Court ruling removes key legal protections from trans women and undermines their rights. The Equality Act should reflect the reality of trans people’s lives and ensure everyone is protected from discrimination and exclusion in public life.

Amend the Equality Act to ensure fairness across sex and gender identity, The Supreme Court ruling enables discrimination against trans people. We call on Parliament to amend the Equality Act to protect the dignity, safety, and rights of all people. Gender identity must not be a legal loophole for exclusion. Everyone deserves equal rights., The Supreme Court ruling limits “sex” in the Equality Act to biology, excluding trans people from vital rights and protections. This risks greater harm to an already vulnerable group. Everyone deserves dignity, safety, and fairness—regardless of sex or gender identity. We urge Parliament to amend the Act to reflect modern understanding and ensure equality before the law for all people.

Overturn the UK's New Legal Definition of a Woman, Overturn the UK's New Legal Definition of a Woman, this would not introduce a new definition, but just remove the current definition as set by the UK Supreme Court., The UK Supreme Court has ruled that the legal definition of a woman is based on biological sex, 'sex is binary' an utterly vague and exclusionary definition.

This disqualifies them from sex-based protections, displaying non-understanding on how misogyny affects trans women. Furthermore, trans women with a Gender Recognition Certificate are also disqualified from classification as a woman.

This practically invalidates the purpose of a Gender Recognition Certificate, and Equality Act 2010.

Stop basing the legal definition of a woman on biological sex., This will do very little besides validate and encourage hatred, prejudice, and violence against transgender people, who have been proven to exist countless times over. This law excludes trans women and includes trans men as women., This law should be reconsidered as it seems the only purpose of defining a woman legally in this way is to exclude trans people, as we all understand the concept of a woman as a gender. Whether or not this was the intention of this law, it will likely provide hateful people with another argument or reason justifying hatred and violence towards trans people, which has already been on the rise as of late. People deserve to feel safe and to be recognised by their own laws.

Amend Law so Definitions of Man & Woman Include Transgender and Intersex People, We want the Government to amend the law so that legal definitions of “woman” and “man” are inclusive of transgender and intersex people, and not restricted to biological sex. We think this would ensure full legal recognition and equal protection for all under the law., We think the Supreme Court ruling limits legal recognition of transgender people and reinforces the exclusion of intersex people by defining legal sex solely as biological. We believe this risks impacting rights, protections, and access to services, and that the law must reflect the diversity of its people and protect all citizens equally, regardless of sex characteristics or gender identity. We think a narrow, biology-only definition risks setting a harmful precedent and undermines the UK’s commitment to equality and human rights.

Allow trans women to legally identify as women in the Equality Act., Allow trans women to be protected as legal women under the Equality Act. They should be allowed to use womens spaces., Trans women are no threat to women. This act also puts trans women at risk. If a trans woman who very much passes as a woman enters a male bathroom, she will be put in danger. Also if a male passing trans man enters the womens bathroom, not only will children be scared, they will receive bad looks and fear from adult women as well.

Overturn the supreme courts decision on Transgender rights, I want equal and fair rights and representation for the transgender community. The right to choose. Equal and fair treatment of men and women who choose to change their gender identity and to be respected of that change., Society has gone backwards and the government has given a voice of hate towards a minority and community.

To update the equality act 2010, The equality act 2010 should be updated to include more Sex, or even change this to Gender and thus should include at least Trans and Non Binary., Due to the recent decision from the high courts on the definition of Sex in the equality act 2010, this now means it is no longer fit for our current society.

There is a lot of people who do not identify as a Man or Woman as outlined by this act, and to make it more inclusive this should now  change from Sex  to Gender or include ender or perceived Gender as another protected characteristics.

This would then aid in people not being discriminated against due to being themselves.

Retain Public Order Act 1986, The Racial & Religious Hatred Act 2006, There have been reports that the United States is asking the UK to repeal parts of its hate speech laws currently protecting individuals, groups & minorities as a condition in any trade deals between the nations. We want the UK government to reject any changes to these laws, as a condition, outright, We want Hate speech laws in their current form to remain in the UK to protect individuals and communities from discrimination, hostility, and violence, while also ensuring the rights of free expression are balanced. These laws aim to prevent the incitement of hatred, violence, and discrimination based on protected characteristics like race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, and disability. We think this deters harmful behaviour and promotes a more inclusive and tolerant society to live in.

Harsher sentences for sex offenders against children., We want harsher punishments for sex offenders against children to ensure justice for victims and community safety. Implement stricter minimum custodial sentences, end early release and enforce stronger monitoring after release., Due to the current minimum terms are not good enough. People who abuse children are getting suspended sentences and its disgraceful! They is no justice for victims after they have their life destroyed and the sex offenders get to walk away free.

Pass legislation to amend the equality act (2010) to include trans women, After the supreme court's recent decision to exclude transgender women from the definition of women in the equality act (2010). We would like parliament to use parliament authority and pass legislation to amend the equality act to include trans women, and to research this area thoroughly., The decision made by the supreme court to exclude trans women from the definition of women in the equality act (2010) will have negative consequences on every women's lives. This will encourage a step backwards on women's rights and will force all women to only be defined by their bodies. This will also have dangerous consequences for transgender women who need services in the medical field, as well as other services such as domestic abuse shelters. This new ruling will only escalate misogyny.

Amend Equality Act to Recognise Trans Women with GRCs as Legal Women, Amend the Equality Act 2010 to ensure that trans women with Gender Recognition Certificates are legally recognised as women for all purposes, including access to single-sex services, legal protections, and public facilities such as hospital wards and shelters., The Supreme Court ruling on 17 April 2025 removed legal recognition of trans women under the Equality Act, even for those with a GRC. This decision strips trans people of dignity, legal protections, and access to essential spaces. It sets a dangerous precedent and increases risks of discrimination, exclusion, and harm. Trans people deserve equality under the law. Parliament must act to restore and protect the rights of one of society’s most vulnerable groups.

Reverse the legal definition of a woman to include Transgender women again., Include Trans women in the definition of a woman
Allow transgender women back into female spaces such as sports and bathrooms.
Stop male police officers strip searching women they see as transgender.
The legal definition changing doesnt just damage transgender women, all women's rights suffer., Reversing equality laws on 'what a woman is' feels like a slippery slope back to discrimination and oppression of all women.
It opens the doors to asking the question where women deserve to be and puts into jeopardy any other minority's and their right to basic human rights, dignity and freedom of expression.
No woman is free until all women are free.
No man is going to put on an eleborate disguise to assult women, he does it anyway. Transgender women are not the problem.

Give trans people legal access to single-sex spaces of their acquired gender, We want the government to give trans people legal access to single-sex spaces of their acquired gender. We feel that the recent supreme court ruling could undermine trans people's access to single-sex spaces and make them vulnerable., Whilst some female only spaces may need to be protected, we think the government could legislate in a way that is more circumstantial and fair to everyone. We are concerned that post-op trans women could be forced into men's changing rooms and post-testosterone trans men could be forced to use women's bathrooms.
 
The Gender Recognition Act (2004) enables people to legally change their gender. The Equality Act (2010) prevents discrimination on the basis of gender reassignment. We think our laws should draw a healthy balance between all parties. We are concerned that the recent supreme court ruling could leave trans people with no alternative spaces to use.

Make Gender Neutral Toilets a legal requirement in all public areas, I want the government to require ender neutral toilets to be provided in public spaces around the UK, including education institutions and shopping outlets., With everything going on in the news at the moment with trans laws, I want everyone to feel inclusive and comfortable using restrooms around the country. As a trans person myself, I want every trans person to feel comfortable going to the bathroom, without worrying about hate crimes or being subject to misgendering. This is very important to myself and other people in the LGBTQ+ community.

Review the way the criminal justice system supports male victims, We want the government to review support for male victims of domestic violence, rape and sexual assault from partners. We are concerned that men are treated as the suspect and that the police may not take serious statements or start a case where men are victims.,

Review Access to HRT & HRT monitoring for Trans People & guidance and training, Review access to HRT & HRT monitoring for trans people and review the guidance and training for GPs on trans healthcare., There are reports of trans people being denied HRT on the NHS and instead having to pay private healthcare fees. We believe blood tests are essential to monitor HRT, and the risks for trans people may be the similar to those going through menopause. Discrimination has no place in healthcare.

Fund paid rest breaks for all NHS nursing staff, Currently many NHS nursing staff are working 12 hour shifts, with unpaid rest breaks. Fund the NHS to pay them their rest time., I have been in a NHS hospital for over two months recovering from major life threatening surgery. The nursing care I have received has been extraordinary. Our nurses work extremely hard. Please provide funding to value their worth and at least pay them while they recharge.

Prevent Sex Offenders from Applying for Removal from the Sex Offenders Register, In July 2012, the Sexual Offences Act 2003 was amended to allow certain convicted sex offenders to apply for removal from the Sex Offenders Register 15 years after release. I respectfully urge this amendment be repealed to protect the public., I believe sexual offences fundamentally breach victims’ human rights, particularly Article 3 of the European Convention on Human Rights, which prohibits torture and inhuman or degrading treatment. Article 3 requires public authorities to prevent such treatment and protect individuals from others who do. I believe allowing removal inherently reduces victim protection and enables reoffending risk, ultimately failing the obligation to protect victims.

While removal may interfere with the offender’s Article 8 right to private life, I believe this interference is justified and necessary, and does not amount to a breach, as I believe the protection of victims outweighs the offenders' rights.

Remove the right for convicted sex offenders to appeal their sentence, As the law stands convicted sex offenders and child predators are entitled to appeal their sentences should they feel the sentencing is to harsh. I wish to remove their right to appeal their sentences., I wish for the law to be changed and for convicted perpetrators to have no right of appeal once sentencing has been passed. I believe that allowing them to appeal can cause more trauma and emotional upset to their victims.

Reconvene the cross house cross party Parliamentary Forum on Trans People, Please reconvene the cross house cross party parliamentary forum on trans people and establish a positive way forward in respect of the implications of the Supreme Court ruling on biological sex and its implication across society., Dr Jane Playdon and retired (2010) MP Lynne Jones set up the original Parliamentary Forum on Transsexualism in 1994 to establish equality in health care and work through legal reform for the protection of trans people in the UK.
The recent Supreme Court ruling on defining sex as biological sex will change that legal reform secured from 1994.
We now again call on Parliament to reconvene this forum to work through the implications of this ruling and develop a mutual way forward.

For Parliament Urgently repeal UK Supreme Court Ruling on Trans Rights, The Supreme Court’s judgment focused on Trans Women and neglected the safeguarding impact for Trans Men and masculine-presenting individuals. 

There is now a higher risk that abusive men could exploit this ruling, as no practical enforcement mechanisms exist, leading to new safeguarding failures., The UK Suprene Court has failed to consider critical safeguarding consequences for the wider population, and created serious new legal and safety risks that have not been properly assessed or explored. 

This amounts to a miscarriage of justice affecting a highly vulnerable and already marginalised and discriminated group (Trans Men and Women) as well as Women generally. 

The Government must take urgent action to intervene.

Legally classify the creation & use of sexual deep fakes as sexual assault, We think that if a person creates a pornographic deep fake it should be classified as sexual assault, as AI use is rising and the use of deep fakes to depict women and girls performing sexual acts is on the rise., We think sexual deep fakes should be classed as sexual assault because they violate a person's consent, autonomy, and dignity. In our view, victims experience real trauma, humiliation, and emotional harm, similar to physical sexual abuse. We think the intent is to sexually exploit or degrade without permission, weaponizing someone's body and identity. Even without physical contact, we think the psychological damage mirrors traditional forms of sexual violence and deserves equal legal recognition and protection.

Create new background checks for jurors on sexual or domestic abuse trials, We urge the Government to change the law so that jurors on any trial for sexual assault, rape or domestic abuse undergo background checks. Any juror who has been a victim or know victims should be disqualified, as we think they may be biased when deciding the verdict., We feel that many innocent young men have been convicted of sexual assault and rape of ex-partners. We are concerned that the lives of some people and their families have been destroyed by false allegations.

Make any sexual contact with an animal a criminal offence, We think the government should recognise gap in current law regarding bestiality and change it. They should make it law that any sexual act with an animal is illegal., Under Section 69 of the Sexual Offences Act 2003, a person commits an offence if they intentionally perform an act of penetration with their penis on the vagina or anus of a living animal. However, the law does not cover other forms of sexual contact with animals, such as oral sex or digital penetration. Any sexual act should be consensual and animals are unable to give consent. This is animal abuse and the law needs to change.

Introduce an elected Supreme Court, Introduce an elected Supreme Court, so that the public can vote to elect the Justices to the Supreme Court, rather than them being appointed., We believe this would open the door to wider political representation and suffrage for the people. We think that if the public can vote in a government, then they should be able to vote in the members of the Supreme Court.

Ban Live Facial Recognition (LFR) in all public and private spaces, We call on the Government to ban the use of Live Facial Recognition (LFR) surveillance in all public and private spaces. This includes by private companies and in retail spaces unless strictly for national security or immediate prevention of terrorism, with strict oversight and judicial approval., We think LFR is a disproportionate response to everyday crime and is expanding with little oversight, risking mass surveillance and loss of privacy. It was recently reported permanent LFRs were being installed in Croydon. As Snowden said, "Arguing that you don't care about the right to privacy because you have nothing to hide is no different than saying you don't care about free speech because you have nothing to say." We believe we must avoid risking civil liberty as the price of public safety.
